visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair and a navy blue "Athletic 08" t-shirt stands on a sidewalk at night. She is positioned in the center of the frame, holding a large, cone-shaped crepe wrapped in a transparent plastic bag. She takes a deliberate bite of the food, looking directly into the lens while chewing thoughtfully. The background features storefronts with Chinese signage and a prominent yellow smiley-face balloon. (2) The woman engages in a silent dialogue with an off-camera individual. She has a yellow scrunchie on her right wrist and uses hand gestures to emphasize her words. Her facial expression is relaxed and playful. The camera work is handheld and slightly shaky. Pedestrians are visible as blurred figures moving in the background behind her under bright artificial shop lighting. (3) The scene shifts to a highly dynamic phase where the woman exhibits extreme facial expressions. She shakes her head and the crepe vigorously, her eyes wide with exaggerated excitement and her mouth open. She points her finger towards the background shops and then back at the crepe, maintaining focus on the camera throughout this intense display of emotion for several seconds. (4) She continues her animated performance, although the intensity slightly decelerates. She looks to her right and then back to the center, gesturing towards herself and the camera operator. She takes another bite of the crepe. A passerby wearing a black shirt walks across the background from left to right. Her expressions remain humorous and character-driven. (5) The woman lowers the crepe and looks down at a black smartphone she is holding in her right hand. Her fingers are seen tapping and scrolling on the screen. The camera focuses more closely on her upper body and the device. Her expression is focused and neutral during this brief interaction with the mobile interface while the street environment remains consistent. (6) She rotates the smartphone to face the camera directly, revealing a transaction screen with the logo "LINE Pay" and the text "NT$520". She looks back at the camera with a satisfied smile, then turns her body away from the viewer to walk into the night as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a clear layer of ambient city noise, characterized by distant traffic hum and the indistinct murmur of an outdoor night market. A prominent high-frequency transient crunch is heard as the female speaker takes a crisp bite of food, followed by soft sounds of chewing. No background music is present, allowing the environmental noise to be audible. (2) A male voice enters the mix, speaking with a moderate pitch and calm conversational delivery. The female voice responds playfully with low arousal. Their dialogue is linear and the speech-to-noise ratio is high. The environment remains stable with no sudden peaks in amplitude as the two interact casually. (3) A sudden acoustic discontinuity occurs as the female voice transitions into a high-energy, high-pitched scream. The vocal arousal level spikes dramatically. She begins a rapid-fire monologue with exaggerated pitch contours and a very high speech rate. Her voice dominates the spectral mix, masking the background street noise floor significantly during this dramatic performance. (4) A second loud, percussive crunching sound is heard as the female speaker bites into the crepe again. This transient has a wide spectral bandwidth. She continues speaking, her tone remaining energetic but slightly more grounded compared to the previous peak. The environmental noise floor is constant and unremarkable compared to the vocal signal. (5) The male voice returns briefly to ask a short question with a neutral falling intonation. This is followed by a few seconds of ambient noise overlaid with the crisp, high-frequency sounds of fingers tapping on a glass screen and the soft rustling of plastic wrapping. This moment of lower vocal energy serves as a narrative transition. (6) The male voice is heard again, saying "Wu er ling" (520) with a clear, enunciated delivery. The female voice follows with a soft, melodic giggle that has a rising pitch contour. The city noise floor persists with a consistent spectral centroid until the track ends abruptly. Overall production is clean field recording style.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Question -> Dramatic Performance -> Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video humorously demonstrates the concept of 'Emotional Value' (情緒價值) in a relationship. A girlfriend performs an exaggeratedly enthusiastic and dramatic reaction to a crepe her boyfriend bought her, fulfilling his request for 'emotional value.' The skit concludes with her showing a money transfer to him, humorously suggesting a payment for the interaction.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video follows a popular social media trend in Mandarin-speaking regions where partners roleplay 'high emotional value' reactions to mundane events.
